no-restricted-syntax.message: DOMAIN VIOLATION: event.tracked_events is a backend relation array and must never be accessed in UI rendering. Use api.listings.byEvent() for listing data.
CARDINALITY VIOLATION: flatMap over an events array can inflate event count beyond API cardinality. Use a partitioning function like sectionize() instead.
FALLBACK VIOLATION: Fallback rendering paths for events are not permitted. If the API fails, render empty state. Never substitute an alternative event source.

no-restricted-globals.name: localStorage
no-restricted-globals.message: TRACKING VIOLATION: localStorage must not be accessed directly in components. Use the useFollowed() hook, which isolates localStorage to ID metadata only and never injects event objects.
